text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'm, like, saaaying, don't you think so 
too, Alv-senpai? I mean, you totally do, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Look at that face~! I knew you'd 
understand, Senpai~♡ *smooch smooch*♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could this mean... Admire Groove and 
Fusaichi Pandora are involved?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Alv-senpai's Trainer! Yahoo~! So 
basically~... I need some advice☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty much the type who thrives on 
compliments~ Like being called cute~ or a 
genius♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Lately, though, everyone just hasn't been 
praising me enough~ We were just talking 
about how since I'm a genius, I deserve 
way more praise and pampering, you know?☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait... H-Hey, Alve-senpai? Where are you 
goiiing~!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*
choice_data_list:
So, were you talking about that the whole 
time?

So, were you talking about that the whole 
time?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yup♪ You're a fellow genius, right, 
Alve-senpai? You totally get this 
frustration, don'tcha♡

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know. Don't lump me in with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No no, I know it! Let's do it together~!! 
Don't be so cold to me, pretty please♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like, honestly, I totally think Alv-senpai 
deserves way more praise, don'tcha think?? 
For real though☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Working hard is like, insanely annoying, 
so keepin' at it forever? You're way too 
awesome—total respect♡

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I only do it because it's necessary.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait!? Like, seriously, I just came up 
with a super great idea!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Opening the 1st Annual Praise-the-Genius 
Party~☆ *Boom boom, puff puff~♪*

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yep! It's a meet-and-greet for everyone 
walking by to shower me and Arve-senpai 
with compliments♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, first target spotteeeed! Kuu-chan 
Senpai, praise me, praise me~♡

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
So I just have to praise the both of them, 
got it!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Miss Pandora is like a bright sun—being 
around her just makes me feel all warm 
inside. She's a total genius at creating a 
warm atmosphere~♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Groove-san's late-race surge is amazing, 
but... when she was mending frayed clothes 
in the dorm, her delicate finishing 
touches were so incredible~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
As expected, you're so good at praising 
people~! I loooove you, Kuu-chan senpai♡

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I think the way you speak your mind 
so frankly like this is both adorable and 
charming, Pandora-san♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?! I am super cute, after 
all~♡

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
There's so much to learn from 
Groove-san... Her diligence in always 
striving to improve both her running and 
her studies. I always respect her 
uncompromising attitude.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... That should be enough, right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh~~~!? That's still not nearly 
enough~☆"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Cesario-chan was saying it too, you know? 
It's seriously unbelievable how she keeps 
up with both training and studying! Even 
though she's a genius!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
A genius deserves to be praised, 
obviously~, and when a genius puts in 
effort, she ought to be spoiled rotten♪ 
Right?♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I don't understand what you mean. 
Enough already, we're done here.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Geez... Alve-senpai, you're way too 
humble~

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Still, wasn't our compliment session 
totally the best? Coming up with that 
makes me an absolute genius~♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hey♪ Alve-senpai, praise me, praise meee♡

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list:
Looks like this won't end unless you 
praise them.
I'll be the one to praise you two!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list:
Looks like this won't end unless you 
praise them.
I'll be the one to praise you two!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Anything's fine, okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
............ ...Haaah. ...I must admit, 
that sheer pushiness of yours... is quite 
something.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Seriously!? Pretty impressive!? A genius!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ......I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaay~~~☆ I got praised by a fellow 
genius~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm. Praise parties really are the 
best! Let's do it again sometime, 
Alve-senpai♡

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Never again. Absolutely not.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer did?
choice_data_list:
Because today, you two are the ones who 
deserve the praise

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Oh, true! Then you should praiiise me♡
choice_data_list:
Genius-level initiative! First prize in 
positivity!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Right~!? Yay, yay! Feelin' super hyped~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Piling effort upon effort as if wearing 
away her very body, constantly sharpening 
and polishing herself. She is—"
choice_data_list:
You're such a hard worker, giving it your 
all! Good job!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
As expected of my Trainer! You really get 
it~♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...What makes you say that?
